response:
I am so incredibly sorry you experienced this. Having a panic attack is already a deeply vulnerable and frightening experience, and having it recorded and shared without your consent is a massive breach of trust and privacy. It is completely understandable that you are feeling hurt, humiliated, and questioning this friendship. 

You do not owe her the benefit of the doubt, especially when her actions caused you public distress instead of offering support. Whether you choose to step away completely or wait for an explanation is entirely up to what feels safest for you right now. If you haven't already, you have every right to demand she take the video down immediately, or you can report the video to the platform yourself. Please prioritize your own emotional well-being right now, and remember that you deserve to surround yourself with people who respect your boundaries and offer genuine care when you need it most.
